name: Kilnwood Roast
purpose: Online store for a small coffee roaster: whole-bean coffee with photos, roast profiles, and prices; guest-first cart and checkout; customers can see their past orders.

entities.name: Product
relationships: belongs to storefront catalog with roast_level/origin/tasting_notes

entities.name: Cart
relationships: session-scoped, holds CartItems keyed by product

entities.name: Order
relationships: stores public_reference, state, totals, legal acceptance

entities.name: Customer
relationships: optional signed-in User; guests identified by email for receipt access

workflows.name: Browse catalog
workflows.description: Guests browse whole-bean coffees with photos, roast level, origin, tasting notes, and prices; filter by roast (light/medium/dark).

workflows.name: Cart
workflows.description: Visitors add products to a session cart, update quantities, and remove items without an account.

workflows.name: Guest checkout
workflows.description: Email + legal consent, server-authoritative pricing, Stripe-ready payment via preview simulator (no money moves in demo); signed 24h receipt link after purchase.

workflows.name: Past orders
workflows.description: Signed-in customers see their own order history; guests reach a receipt via signed expiring access link.

workflows.name: Admin
workflows.description: Madmin product/order management: availability, inventory, CSV import, order states.

seed_demo: Eight whole-bean coffees (light/medium/dark roasts) with origin, tasting notes, prices, and photography; walkable guest checkout via simulator.
